data: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_exchange_import_receipt (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, idempotency_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL UNIQUE, content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, actor_id UUID NOT NULL, space_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES spacemodel(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, response JSONB NOT NULL, created_case_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, embeddings_pending BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW())
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_exchange_import_receipt_actor_idx ON data_exchange_import_receipt (actor_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_exchange_import_receipt_space_idx ON data_exchange_import_receipt (space_id)
